explanation: Brother of Moses and the first high priest in Israel, who belonged to the tribe of Levi.
The supreme religious leader in Israel, responsible for performing sacrifices and ritual acts.
One of the twelve tribes of Israel, appointed to serve God and the Israelite community as priests and temple servants.
The division of the Levites into 24 groups who were to perform service at the temple by rotation.
Mysterious objects used by the high priest to seek counsel from God in important matters.
A method for making decisions using chance, often used in the Bible to determine God's will.
One of Aaron's sons, who succeeded him as high priest.
Another of Aaron's sons, also a priest in Israel.
A list of family members and their ancestors, important for preserving family and tribal identity.
